method: Read-only official documentation via web tool; no library/runtime invoked. Paraphrases, not copied source.

sources.summary: terminate is invoked on parent exit when the server traps exits. Nontrapping nonnormal exits and kill can bypass cleanup. stop invokes terminate. Registration is released on termination; duplicate named start fails.

sources.version: OTP 29.1.2 online documentation; retained execution used OTP 29.1.1
sources.summary: Children start in list order and terminate in reverse order. one_for_all restarts all children after terminating siblings. Infinity shutdown can stall if cleanup never returns.
A table belongs to its creating process and is destroyed when its owner terminates unless ownership/heir behavior is configured. This source configures no heir.
get, put, put_new and erase are separate operations. erase takes a key and returns whether that key existed; there is no compare-value erase operation. Do not describe a get/erase pair as atomic CAS.
